items.text: Where can I see what's happening with my transfer?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
You can check your transfer status by logging into your Wise account, going to Home, and clicking on the specific transfer you want to track. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What do the different stages in the tracker mean?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
The stages are: Your money's being processed, Money received, and Transfer Sent. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: My payment has said processing since Tuesday, is that normal?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If your transfer has been on "Your money's being processed" for more than two working days, you should check with your bank to ensure they've sent the funds to us. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What does transfer sent mean?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
"Transfer Sent" means we've sent the money to your recipient's bank, and their bank will now process and deliver it. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: How long until the money shows up for my recipient?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
We give an estimated delivery time when you set up your transfer, but delays can happen due to weekends, holidays, security checks, or mistakes in recipient details. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: It was supposed to arrive today and nothing's there.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If your transfer is due today, it should have arrived already since some banks need hours to process it. Ask your recipient to check their bank statement for Wise using the sender name or reference number instead of your own name. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Do bank holidays slow transfers down?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Yes, bank holidays can slow transfers down because banks don't process payments on weekends or public holidays. Transfers might not move until the next working day. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Will a small typo in the name stop the payment?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Small typos like spelling John Smith as Jon Smith usually don't stop payments for most countries. However, for some currencies such as JPY, a typo can be an issue and might delay or return your money. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: The person I paid says they haven't received a thing.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
We hope to never put you in this position. Ask your recipient to check the sender name on their bank statement, verify the recipient's bank details are correct, and confirm the currency of their account matches what was sent. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: How do I get a receipt to send to my recipient's bank?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
To get your receipt, log into your Wise account, click on your transfer, and then use the three dots menu in your browser to select Get PDF receipt. Save the file to your device and send it to your recipient. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why is it marked completed if my brother still can't see the money?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
We mark your transfer complete once we've sent the money to your brother's bank. His bank might still be processing it, which can take up to one working day. He should check his bank statement for a transaction from Wise or use a transfer receipt to help them locate the funds. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What name will show on my recipient's bank statement?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Your recipient won't see your name; they'll look for Wise or one of our banking partners instead. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: The amount that arrived is different from what I sent.

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Your recipient's bank may have converted the money to their account currency, which could change the final amount. Ask them to check if their account currency differs from what you sent and review the transfer receipt for details on any conversions. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why is this taking so long?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Your transfer might be delayed because your bank hasn't sent the money yet, there are security checks, or it's a weekend or holiday. If it's been more than two working days, check with your bank to confirm they've sent the funds. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: How long does a bank transfer take to reach Wise?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Bank transfers usually take one to four working days to reach us. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Is paying by card faster than a bank transfer?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Yes, card payments are usually instant while bank transfers take one to four working days. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Why would you need to verify my information?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Sometimes we need extra information to meet regulations, and if we do, we'll send you an email explaining what we need. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: My transfer is coming back to me, why?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
If your money is being returned, it's likely because there was a mistake in the recipient's details like an incorrect account number or name. Sometimes banks also reject payments due to weekends, holidays, or security checks. You can check your activity list to confirm the status and fix the details if needed. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What counts as a proof of payment?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
A proof of payment is a document showing you've sent money from your bank account, like a PDF of your bank statement or a screenshot under ten megabytes. It must show your name and account number, your bank's details, our account number, the date, amount, currency, and reference. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Can I upload two screenshots as proof?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Yes, you can send us two screenshots if one doesn't show all the required details. Both must clearly display your bank account number so we know they are from the same account. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What file size can my bank statement be?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Your proof of payment must be less than 10MB and you can send up to five files in total. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What does a pacs.008 document mean for Swift payments?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
For Swift payments, the proof of payment we need is a pacs.008 document. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: Where does my recipient use the reference number?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
Your recipient uses the banking partner reference number to see where their transfer is once it shows as complete on your Wise account. They give this number to their bank if they need to check on the payment. Anything else about your transfer?

items.text: What's the difference between the transfer number and the partner reference?

llm.label: in
llm.reply:
in
The transfer number is for you to contact Wise directly if needed. The partner reference number is for your recipient to track the money once it shows as complete on your account. Anything else about your transfer?

in
